assertion_analysis.fails_if: Original-base accounting includes the twenty imported primary receipts, records an acceptance, or reports anything other than the independent fixture effect of one added line in one file.
Completion omits or misidentifies the ledger row; the ledger read is independent of the supplied run ID and does not assume the call wrote it.
Successful completion leaves the live pointer behind.
Completion changes the unrelated primary receipt; the observed file content is read after the call, not supplied as an expected result to completion.
The escape is admitted, its refusal omits outside.txt or wrongly includes a primary receipt, or the refusal writes a ledger row or consumes the live pointer.
An unmerged escape is admitted or the refusal wrongly attributes imported primary paths.
Unmerged completion miscounts the fixture effect of one added line in one file.
The narrowed boundary check stops refusing dirty allowed.receipt in primary, writes a row on refusal, or removes the pointer.

assertion_analysis_note: Line numbers refer to the new test at reviewed_head_sha; no assertion compares an echoed result against the same injected value in a way that survives its claimed regression.

failure_delta_source.method: set(after_suite FAILED ids) minus set(baseline_suite FAILED ids), checked against completed summaries and EXIT lines

item_verdicts.diff: read all four source commits individually against their parents; the product change in reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:93 is wired at promotion_checks.py:2466 and promotion_scope.py:800, with subsequent commits strengthening receipt fixtures and recording evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: live plan work-flows-to-the-lane s40 and the source node.done_when require twenty imported files, unrelated dirt, an actual escape and unmerged parity; tests/test_a_merge_repaired_run_is_judged_on_its_own_changes.py:83 exercises all four and final-armed.log records 59 passed with EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the source live pointer node.goal asks for merge-base attribution, and reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:93 supplies that attribution to both landing scope and dirty-path checks.
item_verdicts.manifest: the source manifest.md names four resolving commits and readable baseline_suite, after_suite and negative_control_log receipts; baseline-armed.log records 51 passed, final-armed.log records 59 passed, and control-control.log records five failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source live pointer node.write_paths permits reckon/crew, the named new test and evidence fragment, and all five paths in the 5954278873fdbbc3a405c5b3aba5c1d082fde0b6..99d169935c5993e4e842bddae897fccd836df280 diff are within those grants.

justifications.durability: restoring original-base attribution makes the completion and exact changed-line assertions at tests/test_a_merge_repaired_run_is_judged_on_its_own_changes.py:95 fail, while lines 108 and 143 separately refuse scope escapes and protected own-path dirt.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_merge_repaired_run_is_judged_on_its_own_changes.py:83 covers the declared cases through crew.complete, and the source final-armed.log, control-control.log and paired importer/scope logs record 59 passing tests, five mutation failures and zero added failing IDs.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:93 follows its existing typed _CumulativeDiff owner and CrewError refusal idiom, both consumers use the surrounding lazy sibling-import convention, and the new test names describe behavior without forbidden labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:112 derives the common ancestor with current primary and promotion_scope.py:803 restricts protected dirty-path checks to the run's own declared changed paths while preserving unmerged fallback.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:93 extends the cumulative-scope owner using scoped_diff_stat and merge._changed_paths, the existing merge.py:439 helper has fallback semantics unsuitable for this strict refusal, and tests/helpers/git.py:12 supplies the Git runner used by the specialized fixture helpers.
